title: Co-op D-pad orders and gestures (DPC 0.9.177-dev58)
intro: About 3 minutes, in split-screen co-op as now (player 1 Arisen, player 2 Mage, player 3 Fighter, the Archer a normal AI pawn). Stand together near the Archer. Each step says who presses what; watch, then press End.

probes.presses: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; return R and R.dord_n or 0
probes.last: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; local l=R and R.dord_last; return l and (l.who..' '..l.name..' order='..tostring(l.order)..' gesture='..tostring(l.ges)) or ''
probes.played: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; return R and R.dord_played or 0
probes.p2node: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; local c=R and R.players()[2]; if not c then return '' end; return c:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'):call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',0) or ''

steps.text: Ready: everyone close together, the Archer (AI) nearby, nobody holding any button. Press End.
1/4 PLAYER 2 (Mage): tap the D-pad LEFT once (Wait). Watch: does the Mage do a gesture? Does the Archer stop or say something? Press End.
2/4 PLAYER 3 (Fighter): tap the D-pad UP once (Go). Watch: does the Fighter point? Does the Archer run ahead or say something? Press End.
3/4 PLAYER 2: walk about 10 steps away from the Archer, then tap the D-pad DOWN once (Come). Does the Archer come to you? Press End.
4/4 HANDS OFF. Watch PLAYER 2's Mage: the test makes her do the 'come here' wave by itself, twice.
steps.each_frame:
local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; local c=R and R.players()[2]; if not c then return end
_G.DT_w=_G.DT_w or {t=os.clock(),n=0}
local w=_G.DT_w
if w.n<2 and os.clock()-w.t>=(w.n==0 and 0.5 or 3.0) then
  w.n=w.n+1; w.t=os.clock()
  pcall(function() c:call('get_ActionManager'):call('requestActionCore(app.ActionManager.Priority, System.String, System.UInt32)', 0, 'GesComehere', 0) end)
end

steps.text: Done. Tell Claude what you saw at each step (gesture yes / no, Archer reacted yes / no). Press End.
